articles.title: Powering through uncertainty: A talk with former US Energy Secretary Ernest Moniz
articles.summary: The physicist and policymaker says the coming decade will be defined by a race for electrons—and that nuclear power, grid investment, and new public-private models will be part of the picture.

articles.title: Winning hearts in an age of infinite travel choices
articles.summary: Travelers’ discovery and booking journeys have been reshaped. How can travel players show up at every turn on the path from search to certainty?

articles.title: The future of healthy living: A $16.4 trillion opportunity
articles.summary: New McKinsey Health Institute analysis finds that addressing modifiable risk factors could add 12 years to healthy life expectancy at birth and add nearly 9 percent to the global economy by 2050.

articles.title: Ready to ramp? How US manufacturers can scale at pace
articles.summary: US manufacturers have a once-in-a-generation opportunity to reshore the production of critical and at-risk goods, but to do so, they will need to aggressively ramp up production from today’s levels.

articles.title: Value is the compass. Consumers set the pace.
articles.summary: In the 10th edition of McKinsey’s automotive consumer survey, China’s car buyers reveal where value is heading—and why the road ahead is exciting for consumers everywhere.
